subject: Hybrid platform handoff: ON24→Zoom bridge + sponsor clip & recording release
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie@brightwave.events>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@clientcorp.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hybrid platform handoff: ON24→Zoom bridge + sponsor clip & recording release

Team / Sophie,

Thanks for partnering with us on the ClientCorp product keynote (May 4). A few operational asks to lock the handoff between ON24 (primary) and Zoom (RTMP fallback):

- Confirm ON24→Zoom RTMP bridge is supported for our plan and any extra licensing is required on your side. If supported, we need the bridge destination (rtmp url + stream key) and expected failover behavior (instant vs buffer).
- Registration fields: we need to map ON24 registrant fields to our CRS. Minimum required: first_name, last_name, email, company, job_title, country, marketing_opt_in (boolean). Please confirm field IDs.
- Sponsor pre-roll: ClientCorp requires a 30s MP4 (H.264, 720p, 30fps) pre-roll + 5s slate with sponsor logo. What are your preferred file naming and delivery method?
- Recording & release: ClientCorp needs recordings retained for 90 days, with a signed speaker/sponsor release. Can you send your standard speaker release template or accept ours (attached draft)?
- Dry run: propose Wed 24 Mar at 10:00 AM PT for an end-to-end encoder→ON24→Zoom fallback test. Can ops join?

I've attached the sponsor spec and our current field mapping (draft). Sophie — please confirm what you need from us to turn the bridge on. Lauren / Ben, tagging you for legal and registration mapping review.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Events Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: sponsor_pre-roll_specs.pdf, registration_field_map.csv
From: Sophie Chen <sophie@brightwave.events>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@clientcorp.com>
Cc: On24 Ops <ops@on24.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Hybrid platform handoff: ON24→Zoom bridge + sponsor clip & recording release

Hi Karthik / Alex — thanks, this is clear. Quick answers from BrightWave Ops and ON24: 

- ON24 RTMP fallback: ON24 supports a configured RTMP target to stream to Zoom as a fallback. We will need destination RTMP URL + stream key from Zoom/Redwood. ON24's bridge is near-real-time; expect a 3–6s buffer during switchover (we'll confirm in the dry run).
- Field mapping: please send the CSV (we received registration_field_map.csv). We'll return a mapping with ON24 field IDs by EOD Tue.
- Sponsor pre-roll: Accepting MP4 H.264 720p 30s. Please include a 5s slate with sponsor logo and a 1s black buffer at start. Filename convention: CLIENT_sponsor_preroll_v1.mp4. Delivery: upload to this Drive folder (link below) or SFTP — whichever you prefer.
- Recording retention & release: BrightWave can store the recording for 90 days. We need a signed release per speaker and a sponsor approval email. We can accept DocuSign; please send the powerform link.

We can join the dry run on 2027-03-24 10:00 AM PT. I've looped in On24 Ops for bridge details.

Best,
Sophie Chen
Senior Producer | BrightWave Events
sophie@brightwave.events

Thanks Sophie — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few follow-ups / clarifications: 

1) RTMP destination: Ben — can you confirm if Redwood will host the Zoom fallback channel and share the RTMP endpoint + stream key? If Redwood will not host, we'll need ClientCorp's Zoom destination.
2) Speaker release: attaching our latest speaker_release_v3.docx (small edits from Legal). Sophie — if BrightWave has a standard clause you prefer, we're happy to merge.
3) Delivery: we'll upload the pre-roll to the Drive link you provided. I'll coordinate final asset delivery with our external PM.
4) Dry run confirmation: Wed 24 Mar 10:00 AM PT is confirmed on our side. Please include an encoder test (we'll bring a local OBS instance) and a forced failover to verify the 3–6s behavior.

Action items:
- Ben: please prepare the Zoom RTMP destination or confirm Redwood hosting by Tue EOD.
- Lauren: please review speaker_release_v3.docx and confirm sign-off or edits.
- Sophie/On24 Ops: return ON24 field IDs for mapping and confirm ops bridge checklist.

Thanks,
Karthik
